# mcloud call

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/gendocs`: edit the source it names, not this file. -->

_Generated from the command's help in `internal/cli`._

[All commands](README.md)

Send a request to an HTTP function, private ones too.

Send one HTTP request to a function and print the response (status,
headers, body). It's sent from a short-lived pod in the app's namespace, so
private (cluster-local) functions answer it too, and a function scaled to
zero starts for it.

```
mcloud call FUNCTION [PATH] [flags]
```

Examples:

```fish
mcloud call api /health
mcloud call api /items -X POST -d '{"name":"x"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
mcloud call api /items -d @item.json
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--app` string |  | the app (default: $MCLOUD\_APP, else maxcloud.yaml's) |
| `-d`, `--data` string |  | request body; @FILE reads it from a file |
| `-H`, `--header` stringArray |  | a header, "Name: value" (repeatable) |
| `-X`, `--request` string |  | HTTP method (default GET, or POST with -d) |
